invoice_lines_procedure_once_uq.name: invoice_lines_procedure_once_uq
invoice_lines_procedure_once_uq.where: performed_procedure_id is not null and released = false

invoices_issued_has_number.name: invoices_issued_has_number
invoices_issued_has_number.value: "invoices"."status" = 'draft' or ("invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."document_date" is not null)

cash_sessions_close_complete.name: cash_sessions_close_complete
cash_sessions_close_complete.value: "cash_sessions"."status" = 'open' or ("cash_sessions"."counted_minor" is not null and "cash_sessions"."expected_minor" is not null and ("cash_sessions"."counted_minor" = "cash_sessions"."expected_minor" or "cash_sessions"."discrepancy_reason" is not null))

expenses_paid_complete.name: expenses_paid_complete
expenses_paid_complete.value: "expenses"."status" <> 'paid' or ("expenses"."paid_on" is not null and "expenses"."payment_method" is not null)

inventory_item_identifiers_deactivation_.name: inventory_item_identifiers_deactivation_complete
inventory_item_identifiers_deactivation_.value: ("inventory_item_identifiers"."is_active" and "inventory_item_identifiers"."deactivated_at" is null and "inventory_item_identifiers"."deactivated_by_user_id" is null) or (not "inventory_item_identifiers"."is_active" and "inventory_item_identifiers"."deactivated_at" is not null and "inventory_item_identifiers"."deactivated_by_user_id" is not null)

patient_contacts_reference.name: patient_contacts_reference
patient_contacts_reference.value:
(("patient_contacts"."reason"::text in ('appointment_reminder', 'no_show') and "patient_contacts"."appointment_id" is not null and "patient_contacts"."treatment_plan_id" is null and "patient_contacts"."visit_date" is null)
       or ("patient_contacts"."reason"::text in ('treatment_followup', 'estimate_followup') and "patient_contacts"."treatment_plan_id" is not null and "patient_contacts"."appointment_id" is null and "patient_contacts"."visit_date" is null)
       or ("patient_contacts"."reason"::text in ('recall', 'referral_thanks') and "patient_contacts"."appointment_id" is null and "patient_contacts"."treatment_plan_id" is null and "patient_contacts"."visit_date" is null)
       or ("patient_contacts"."reason"::text = 'after_visit' and "patient_contacts"."visit_date" is not null and "patient_contacts"."appointment_id" is null and "patient_contacts"."treatment_plan_id" is null)
       or ("patient_contacts"."reason"::text = 'installment_due' and "patient_contacts"."appointment_id" is null and "patient_contacts"."treatment_plan_id" is null and "patient_contacts"."visit_date" is null))
       and (("patient_contacts"."reason"::text = 'installment_due') = ("patient_contacts"."installment_id" is not null))
